title: Illustrative batch memory envelope
method: Synthetic peak model = 180 MiB idle + 70 MiB per concurrent batch. Compare with a 512 MiB limit; five batches exceed it by 18 MiB. Allocator, native and nonlinear overheads are not measured.
alt: Illustrative batch memory envelope. One batch: 250 MiB; Three batches: 390 MiB; Five batches: 530 MiB. Illustrative inputs.
